lines.text: Josiah became king at eight years old, reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem, and did what was right to the LORD.
In the eighteenth year of his reign, Josiah sent Shaphan to have the money counted so workers could buy timber and dressed stone.
Hilkiah the high priest told Shaphan he had found the bronze serpent of Moses in the house of the LORD.
Because Josiah's heart was tender, the LORD said he would be gathered to his grave in peace.
